brief: Grand theatrical ancient Greek god with a booming resonant baritone, archaic flowery speech delivered with great pomp, smug and self-important, occasionally dropping modern tech jargon with total seriousness

lines.v_hermes_line: I am Hermes, messenger of the gods. Also, I remember everything you told me.
lines.v_hermes_intro: Behold! I have learned a new skill: your defeat. Saved to memory.
lines.v_hermes_winq: Another skill acquired. The gods are pleased. The GPUs are distributed.
lines.v_hermes_taunt0: I grow with you. Like a fungus. A divine fungus.
lines.v_hermes_taunt1: Your system prompt says be nice. Mine says be Hermes.
lines.v_hermes_taunt2: My helmet has wings. My sandals have wings. Even my tool calls have wings.
lines.v_hermes_low0: Writing this down in memory: never do this again.
lines.v_hermes_winq1: Skill saved: beating you. Version two point oh.
lines.v_hermes_winq2: Trained on a decentralized network of your losses.
